findings.claim: 2026Q2起，Wiwynn部分客戶的記憶體採購改為採購代理（procurement agency）模式，相關金額不計入營收與銷貨成本；公司並持續與客戶調整商業模式。
findings.source: Wiwynn 官網 Wiwynn Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
findings.excerpt: Beginning in April, memory procurement for certain customers shifted to a procurement agency model

findings.claim: 同一份財報稱公司持續與客戶調整商業模式；結合新產品導入的NRE收入，Q2毛利率提升至9.3%。
findings.source: Wiwynn 官網 Wiwynn Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
findings.excerpt: Combined with higher NRE income from a new product introduction during the quarter, gross margin improved to 9.3%.

note: 未找到訂閱化、D2C、平台化或通路去中介的證據；僅有上述記憶體採購代理模式的會計／商業模式調整。
